rows.title: Shennan Circuits 2026 private placement passes SZSE listing review center
rows.detail: Placement to no more than 35 specific investors, proceeds (after fees) for the Wuxi Shennan Circuits AI compute electronic circuit products project and working capital; board approved 2026-06-12, state-owned-asset approval disclosed 2026-07-09, shareholders approved 2026-08-14, amount cut 2026-09-08, SZSE listing review center approval 2026-10-14 (per the 2026 Q3 report). Amount as stated: RMB 436,735.20 ten-thousand (reduced from RMB 488,196.88 ten-thousand on 2026-09-08).
